EVM McAloo Tikki Burger® is one of the popular dishes at McDonald's. It is prepared with quality ingredients and offers a satisfying taste for customers ordering from Connaught Place.

Medium Fries

Medium Fries is another preferred item from the menu. It is a good choice for customers looking to enjoy tasty indian food in Delhi.
